jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare-operations match with direct operational ownership in a major health system. Strong overlap with healthcare workflows, staff coordination, reporting, process improvement, and cross-functional execution.
jobs.gap: The lower end of the range is below target, so compensation should be clarified early. Department-specific experience may be preferred.

jobs.title: Manager, Service Operations and Strategy
jobs.why: Strong healthcare operations and strategy role with a remote structure and compensation comfortably above target. Good fit for process improvement, operational systems, cross-functional execution, and healthcare-domain experience.
jobs.gap: The role may favor candidates with deeper medical-device/service-operations experience. Emphasize transferable healthcare operations, systems, reporting, and process-design work.

jobs.title: Sr. Training Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent intersection of healthcare, training, operations, and scalable process execution. Directly relevant to provider training, onboarding systems, workflow standardization, and cross-functional program management.
jobs.gap: The senior title may come with expectations for broader enterprise training-operations tenure. Lead with hands-on training ownership and systems/process work without overstating scope.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Program Manager, Central Operations
jobs.why: High-upside operations-program role centered on scalable execution, cross-functional programs, operating systems, and process rigor. Strong match for systems-project management and workflow-building strengths.
jobs.gap: This is a senior stretch role and may expect deeper large-scale program ownership. Position 0-to-1 systems work, automation, reporting, and cross-functional execution clearly.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Support Operations
jobs.why: Strong systems-and-operations opportunity at a workforce technology company, with substantial overlap in operational planning, process improvement, reporting, support workflows, and scalable systems.
jobs.gap: Senior-manager scope may require more years of direct support-operations leadership and people management than the current profile demonstrates. Treat as a stretch application.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.why: Remote operations role with explicit healthcare-policy, CMS, leadership, and program-operations elements. Relevant to healthcare administration, process execution, team coordination, and operational systems.
jobs.gap: The lower end falls slightly below target and CMS/call-center depth may be preferred. Highlight healthcare operations and transferable program/process leadership.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Practice Operations
jobs.why: High-paying remote practice-operations role involving client delivery, operational structure, and program execution. Strong match for project management, systems thinking, and cross-functional operations.
jobs.gap: Likely expects consulting/practice-management depth and more senior tenure. Travel is also required, so this is best treated as a stretch role.

jobs.title: Operations Manager - Clinical Engineering
jobs.why: Healthcare operations role with compensation fully above the target floor and strong alignment to operational coordination, reporting, process management, and work inside a complex health system.
jobs.gap: Clinical engineering/biomedical operations is a specialized domain. Emphasize healthcare operations and systems/process strengths while being transparent about the technical domain gap.

jobs.title: Workplace Project Manager
jobs.why: Strong project-operations opportunity with meaningful compensation and overlap in planning, coordination, stakeholder management, execution, and building scalable operational processes.
jobs.gap: Workplace/facilities project experience is not a core part of the current background, making this a broader operations stretch rather than a direct healthcare match.

jobs.title: Manager, HIM Operations & Coding
jobs.why: Local hybrid healthcare-operations role meeting the salary threshold, with leadership and operational-process responsibilities in a healthcare setting.
jobs.gap: Health Information Management and coding expertise are specialized requirements and may be a significant gap. Apply only if the posting does not require a specific coding/HIM credential that is mandatory.
